history.sg_progress: Preliminary information has been received from the consulting actuary, and it is being reviewed to determine appropriate contribution rates and reserve levels and implementation options, taking into consideration the affordability of contributions for participating staff and retirees and the total contributions required to ensure the sustainability of the Plan. Reviewing the Medical Insurance Plan is a major undertaking and the affordability of the plan for locally recruited staff and retirees is one of several financial elements requiring review, which include regional loss ratios, the bases for participant contributions and overall benefit coverage. Each of these reviews is necessary and interdependent to ensure the ultimate sustainability of the Plan. The significant breadth of the review, the fact that relevant after-service health insurance participant data were not recorded in Umoja until 2022, the interdependency of the relevant components requiring review, and the required actuarial input and strategizing of the restructuring necessary to ensure Plan sustainability, in addition to a lack of adequate resources to conduct the reviews, have delayed the implementation of this recommendation.
